approvers: Developer / main contractor, glazing subcontractor, commercial director
reason: I spend about 12 euro per m2 now with film and our own labour, and this is about 19, so it is over 50% dearer for something that mostly protects the glazing sub's work. The subcontract package says who protects what, and I cannot change that on my own.
objection: The glazing subcontractor is responsible for damage until handover, not me, and the developer sets the protection spec and who pays. Why would I pay 58% more for something I can't charge to anyone?
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film and plastic sheet with tape, applied and removed by our own labour.
would_change_my_mind: A developer or glazing subcontractor naming it in the subcontract package and paying for it, or proof from a local premium block that it cut glazing callbacks and snagging by more than the extra cost, at roughly the price of film.
